overview: Invest Punjab – Business First Portal is a state-level initiative by the Punjab Bureau of Investment Promotion (Invest Punjab) that serves as a single point of contact for investors seeking to set up businesses in Punjab. It provides state-level regulatory clearances, approvals for fiscal incentives, and facilitates the entire investment lifecycle from proposal to implementation. The portal operates under the 'Business First' philosophy, aiming to reduce compliance burden, ensure time-bound digital approvals, and foster a conducive environment for growth, innovation, and employment generation.
objectives: To act as a single point of contact for facilitation of investors looking to set up a business in Punjab
To provide state-level regulatory clearances and approvals for fiscal incentives
To offer a unified and transparent interface for all regulatory and fiscal services throughout the investment lifecycle
To guide investors through the entire investment lifecycle – from initiating the proposal to setting up the business
To maintain integrity while serving investors promptly and transparently
To build long-term relationships with the state's industries
To support the MSME sector and facilitate its growth as the backbone of Punjab’s economy
To position Punjab as a global investment destination and boost high-quality jobs in the State
eligibility: Investors looking to set up a business in Punjab, including domestic and international investors, startups, MSMEs, and industries seeking state-level regulatory clearances and fiscal incentives through the Invest Punjab portal.
benefits: Unified regulator for 40+ state-level approvals across 12+ departments, dedicated relationship manager, time-bound and digital approvals, power at affordable rates, peaceful labour relations, one-stop clearance system, attractive incentives, robust infrastructure, skilled human capital, and facilitation of fiscal incentives and regulatory approvals via the Business First Portal.
financial_support: Invest Punjab does not directly provide financial support such as grants, loans, or subsidies. Instead, it facilitates access to fiscal incentives and regulatory approvals through the state government, and supports investors in availing benefits from central and state schemes, including partnerships with SIDBI for MSME development.
application_process: 1. Visit the Invest Punjab Business First Portal at https://investpunjab.gov.in 2. Complete investor registration and login 3. Submit the Online Common Application Form (CAF) for regulatory clearances 4. Apply online for fiscal incentives 5. Receive digital regulatory approvals and make e-payments through the Unified Regulator system 6. Access dedicated helpdesk for assistance 7. Utilize aftercare services for continuous industry engagement
required_documents: Details of investment and employment generation
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Punjab Bureau of Investment Promotion (Invest Punjab), Government of Punjab
caveats: Services are limited to regulatory clearances and facilitation; direct financial assistance is not provided
Approval timelines are subject to departmental compliance and document completeness
Certain approvals may require physical verification or site inspection
The portal facilitates access to incentives but does not guarantee fiscal benefit disbursement
Services are primarily for setting up new businesses or expansions in Punjab
